title: SmallGrants: an open index of US foundation giving from IRS Form 990-PF filings
description:
A reproducible pipeline that turns the IRS Form 990-PF bulk XML archives into a searchable index of 8,388,280 grant records paid by 142,806 US private foundations, filing years 2022 to 2026, together with a web application that ranks funders against a described project by cause, geography and grant size, and reviews a specific ask against each foundation's own filing.

Includes measured validation of the corpus, entity resolution to the IRS Business Master File, and a record of what failed testing. See DATASHEET.md for composition, collection and limitations.
